svg.title: What steepness does
svg.desc: Four profiles of the same wave with Q·k·A equal to 0, 0.5, 1 and 1.5. Higher values pull points towards the crest: sharp crests, flat troughs, a point at 1 and a self-intersecting loop above 1.
svg.text: The shader moves points sideways by Q·A, so the shape depends on Q·k·A.
With the script's default values each wave has Q·k·A of at most about 0.02, so on its
own every wave is very close to a sine. The look comes from adding many of them.
